text.en:
The Secretary of Public Works, Transportation and Communications shall immediately construct
and develop the port and harbor facilities within the area subject of Proclamation No. 1265 dated May 21,
1974, between the municipalities of Gonzaga and San Vicente, Cagayan. The Secretary in hereby authorized
to expropriate in behalf of the National Government, if and when necessary, all private lands within the
vicinity which are needed by the Government for the purpose.

The sum of Three Million Pesos (P3,000,000.00) is hereby appropriated out of any funds from
the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated to carry out the purposes of this Decree.

All laws, decrees, rules and regulations or parts thereof inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed
or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 23rd day of May, in the year of Our Lord nineteen hundred and seventy-four.
